purpose: Prevent alpha self-heating from being double-counted as both plasma heating and direct laser-wall heat.

alpha_self_heating.required_replacement: Compute from escaped/deposited alpha power using the qualified plasma transport and orbit-loss model.

plasma_heating_balance.formula: P_external_laser_absorbed_required = max(0, P_total_absorbed_heating_required - P_alpha_to_plasma - P_RF_absorbed - P_other_absorbed)

prescribed_pulse_wall_screen.case_selection: Separately prescribed optical-on pulse train, not steady supplemental-heating requirement.
prescribed_pulse_wall_screen.component_wall_energy_condition: Component bounds assume the same fixed nominal coupling and maximum transfer for both pulse components; component-resolved coupling is not established.

required_wall_energy_tally.requirement: Use the same shot, optical reference plane, geometry revision and beam/component schedule for numerator and denominator. Direct laser absorption at the liquid wall excludes plasma radiation, alpha, neutron and gamma energy.

laser_conversion_and_wall_loss.wall_fraction_note: The two upper bounds apply only at their stated coupling values and to direct uncoupled laser energy. Setting the uncoupled-to-wall transfer fraction to 1 defines a maximum screening boundary, not an actual deposition estimate. Plasma re-radiation and other wall sources require separate accounting.

other_plasma_facing_surface_sources.rule: Escaped alpha power may be a wall source; deposited alpha self-heating may not be copied into a wall source.

pulse_definition_required.pulse_duration_semantics: Gaussian FWHM of the long preconditioning component in the recovered notebook waveform preset.
pulse_definition_required.fast_spike_duration_semantics: Gaussian FWHM of the fast spike in the recovered notebook waveform preset.
pulse_definition_required.duty_factor_semantics: Existing component duty_factor fields equal FWHM times repetition rate, not true finite-support on-time for a Gaussian. The combined timing-dependent duty remains unresolved.

source.name: TOMAHAWK_Verified_Quick_Run.ipynb
source.transfer_note: Only the documented pulse split and waveform preset are recovered here. Notebook coupling of 0.86 is not silently substituted for this contract's nominal coupling of 0.268574.

peak_power_coefficients.semantics: Legacy field names: these expressions are E_component / FWHM power scales, or rectangular-pulse peaks if explicitly using a flat top. They are not normalized Gaussian peaks.

normalized_gaussian_component_peaks_scre.normalization: 801 uniformly spaced samples per component; normalize exp(-0.5*(t/sigma)^2) by its trapezoidal time integral. Component peak equals its energy divided by that integral.
normalized_gaussian_component_peaks_scre.sigma_rule: sigma = component_FWHM / 2.355, matching the notebook preset
normalized_gaussian_component_peaks_scre.timing_note: These are individual component peaks, not a combined transient or local wall heat flux. Component delay and per-port timing remain unresolved.

mandatory_solver_guards: The 16 port allocation fractions must sum to one when wall laser power is nonzero.
Deposited alpha self-heating may appear only in the plasma balance.
Escaped alpha power must be derived independently before assignment to a wall boundary.
A transient solve requires pulse shape, duration, repetition rate, and per-port allocation.
Peak and cycle-averaged heat fluxes must be stored as different variables.
blockers: target-specific validation of the recovered 50/50 Gaussian pulse preset; component delay and per-port timing
